Name: Underground Secrets REDUX
Author: klatuprism
Description:
[size=3]Updated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6597]Underground Secrets[/url]  by aedenthorn to be 1.6 compatible.

[b]Permissions Disclaimer:[/b]
Aedenthorn has retired from SDV modding and has removed all restrictions on permissions concerning their mods.
This announcement can be found [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/1194051284177801307]here [/url]in the Stardew Valley Modding Discord server.

Aedenthorn's [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]Stardew Valley Mod repo[/url] uses the GPL-3 license which allows derivative works to be allowed without requiring permission, given that they remain free, open source, and also use the same GPL-3 license.

[/size][size=4][b]Original Description[/b][/size][size=3]
Underground is an enigmatic place... secrets abound.

This mod aims to make the underground more interesting.


[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Suspicious shrines
[*]Enchanting altars
[*]Rousing riddles
[*]Tormenting traps
[*]Collapsing caverns
[*]Fungal Flora
[/list]
By default, these secrets are now quite rare close to the surface, but you can modify the [b]config.json[/b] file to change that.

For more detailed information (i.e. spoilers), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/477]I've created an article with all the information on the mod[/url].

This is a work-in-progress and there may be bugs.

I recommend that you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7685]Treasure Chests Expanded[/url]﻿ to allow for more modular rewards.

Source Code: [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/Aedenthorn-StardewValleyMods/tree/master/UndergroundSecrets]Github[/url]
[/size]
